description: Called when an error group is created, takes a new occurrence, or changes state. No args; filter on input.group_id or input.op (created, occurrence or status). Occurrence events are coalesced per group over one second; re-read the group rather than trusting the event.

GroupChangeReasonV1.description: Why a group changed, as `sentinel::on-group-changed` tells its observers.

oneOf.description: A new occurrence on a group that is otherwise unchanged. Coalesced.

GroupStatusV1.description: The lifecycle of a group. `resolved` and `ignored` are human decisions; `regressed` is the one the ingest makes on its own, and the reason the worker exists.

oneOf.description: The first pass of an investigation is running.
A new occurrence after a resolve.

request_schema.description: `sentinel::on-group-changed`: the event siblings and the console observe. Unknown fields are ignored on input, so a call routed through the engine (which stamps `_caller_worker_id`) still parses.
request_schema.title: GroupChangedEventV1
